newsitem.title: USA: JLG Industries to expand boom lift in 1997.
newsitem.headline: JLG Industries to expand boom lift in 1997.

text.p: JLG Industries Inc said Thursday it planned to expand its boom lift facility in McConnellsburg by 108,000 square feet by spring 1997.
JLG, which makes, distributes and markets aerial work platforms throughout the world, also said it expected its second scissor facility in Bedford, Pennsylvania, to be working in early 1997.
JLG reported $13.6 million in net income for the fourth quarter ending July 31, nearly double the $7.1 million reported for the same period last year.
